verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's API docs say you can programmatically manage API keys, so you can issue credentials for an agent. However, nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped to specific permissions, datasets, or read-only access, or that least-privilege keys exist for MCP or agent use. missing for 10: documented per-key permission scopes, least-privilege or read-only key options, agent- or MCP-specific credential scoping guidance, independent corroboration.
